name: heatsync-extension
description: Custom emotes for Twitch, Kick, and YouTube live chat — 5000 slots, real-time sync, multichat overlay

scripts.test:smoke: bun run build.js chrome --minify && bun scripts/smoke-extension.ts
scripts.test:smoke:firefox: bun run build.js firefox --minify && bun scripts/smoke-firefox.ts
scripts.test:freshness:firefox: bun run build.js firefox --minify && bun scripts/freshness-firefox.ts
scripts.test:render: bun run build.js chrome --minify && bun scripts/render-extension.ts
scripts.test:rtl: bun run build.js chrome --minify && bun scripts/render-rtl.ts
scripts.test:emotes: bun run build.js chrome --minify && bun scripts/render-emote-collisions.ts && bun scripts/render-emote-collisions-native.ts && bun scripts/render-emote-collisions-kick.ts
scripts.test:e2e-live: bun run build.js chrome --minify && bun scripts/e2e-live.ts
scripts.test:heap: bun run build.js chrome --minify && bun scripts/heap-soak.ts
scripts.test:heap-tabs: bun run build.js chrome --minify && bun scripts/heap-tabs.ts
scripts.test:heap-budget: bun run build.js chrome --minify && bun scripts/heap-budget.ts
scripts.test:heap-budget:quick: bun run build.js chrome --minify && bun scripts/heap-budget.ts --quick
scripts.typecheck:signal: bun run build.js chrome && node scripts/type-signal.mjs
